node.title: Residual-free top-band petal charts have auxiliary list size at most the petal count
node.statement: For petal size ell, petal count m>=2, retained residual r=0, and the pinned top band d>=ell(m-2), the auxiliary agreement a=ell+d satisfies a^2-dmell>=ell^2. The exact Johnson theorem therefore bounds the complete auxiliary list by m. K4's sub-Johnson kernel is confined to retained-residual charts.
